runtime_boundary.batch: exact fixed-order full batch captured by the source GFG
runtime_boundary.historical_parameter_and_adam_state: restored byte-exactly from materialized source-GFG payloads
runtime_boundary.historical_rng_payload: not materialized in the archived source GFGs
runtime_boundary.causal_rng_policy: derive a deterministic current-runtime RNG state from contract_sha256, entry_id and optimizer_step; restore the identical state for every matched branch and verify its commitments
runtime_boundary.rng_operationality: the frozen model has dropout=0 and the fixed full-batch forward/backward/update path contains no admitted stochastic operator
runtime_boundary.claim_boundary: branch differences are authoritative within the content-bound current runtime; historical native exact replay is claimed only when all available next-state object hashes match

full_scan.full_step: forward, backward, global gradient clipping, AdamW optimizer.step
full_scan.skip_step: the same forward, backward and global gradient clipping with ExplicitDisposition(OPTIMIZER_UPDATE_SKIPPED_BY_FROZEN_MATCHED_CONTROL)

anchor_selection.future_outcome_use: only to define the four pre-registered anchor categories; never used as a transition-model feature

deep_branches.full_update: real forward, backward, clipping and AdamW update
deep_branches.skip_update: same forward, backward and clipping; no parameter or Adam mutation
deep_branches.parameter_only: use the independently replayed full-update parameter poststate with the exact Adam prestate
deep_branches.optimizer_state_only: use the independently replayed full-update Adam poststate with the exact parameter prestate
deep_branches.alignment: training opportunities, not optimizer internal step

generation_fact_model.large_tensor_policy: content-addressed external payload with identity, version, shape, dtype, canonical order, SHA-256 and locator
generation_fact_model.identity_rule: numerically equal branch results retain distinct occurrence and fact identities

validation_gates: source parameter and Adam payload hashes
branch tensor isolation and RNG restoration
full-update comparison to available historical next-state commitments
CSRG repeated-output equality and hook removal
GeneratedOrigin resolution and external payload hashes
matched branches share one immutable prestate
independent GPU replay selected without reading branch results

independent_replay.selection: for every entry, hash-rank all 100 optimizer steps by SHA256(contract_sha256,entry_id,optimizer_step) and replay the minimum-ranked checkpoint
independent_replay.expected_match: branch state, support state, effect and graph commitments
